labels:
Show open house information on listing detail pages

When enabled, available open house information will appear on listing detail pages. When disabled, open house information will be hidden.

Limit to my featured listings only

Limit display to your featured listings only (listings where you or your brokerage represent the seller).

Allow leads to search for open houses

When enabled, visitors on your website will have the option to filter search results by open houses. When disabled, this option will be hidden.

Limit to my featured listings only

Limit display to your featured listings only (listings where you or your brokerage represent the seller).
